items.t: Timing chain stretch and VVT rattle on cold start
items.job: Replace timing chain, VVT actuator and guides
items.note: Price assumes it is caught before the chain jumps.

items.t: Engine destroyed when the timing chain or VVT gear breaks
items.job: Replace engine with a used or remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report dealer quotes near $9,000 for a new engine; a used engine costs less.

items.job: Replace turbocharger and oil feed line
items.note: Replace or clean the oil feed line and screen at the same time.

items.t: Blue or white exhaust smoke from turbo oil seepage
items.job: Diagnose PCV system and turbo seals; replace PCV parts
items.note: If the turbo seals are worn, the cost moves toward a turbo replacement.

items.t: Sudden loss of power while driving
items.job: Diagnose loss of power and repair the faulty boost, throttle or VVT part
items.note: Cost depends on the cause found.

items.t: A/C compressor clutch fails and A/C blows warm
items.note: Sometimes only the clutch needs replacing, which costs less.

items.t: Front ball joints can corrode and separate (recall)
items.job: Replace both front lower control arms

items.t: Low-beam headlights burn out or fail from moisture
items.job: Replace headlight bulb or headlight assembly
items.note: A bulb is cheap; a full housing costs more if moisture keeps getting in.

items.t: Rough idle and lack of power with lean fuel codes
items.job: Diagnose and repair sensor wiring or update engine software

items.t: Unstable idle or stalling from a dirty throttle body
items.job: Clean or replace the throttle body
items.note: Cleaning is often enough; replacement is the upper end.

items.t: Check engine light from a stuck intake shutter valve
items.job: Repair or replace intake shutter valve
items.note: May be covered by Mazda's emissions campaign.

items.t: Check engine light from an evap leak at the fuel filler pipe
items.job: Smoke test evap system and replace filler pipe or seal

items.t: Squeak from the front stabilizer bar
Clunk from a worn engine mount
Gear oil leak from the transfer case seal
items.job: Replace transfer case seal and top up gear oil

items.t: Airbag warning light from a wiring fault
items.job: Diagnose airbag system and repair connector or wiring
Replace front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Musty smell from the A/C vents
items.job: Replace cabin filter and clean evaporator
